name: Red Curry Soup
subtitle: From the cafeteria lady at the Oakland Temple

steps.title: Brown the meat
steps.body: Brown **1 pound ground chicken or pork**, **1 Tbsp Red Curry Paste**, **1 Tbsp ground garlic**, **½ cup chopped red onion** and **3 Tbsp vegetable oil**.

steps.title: Add the coconut milk
steps.body: Add **1 can coconut milk**, about **8 Thai lemon leaves** and about **2 Tbsp galanga root**, grated.

steps.title: Boil the vegetables
steps.body: In **5 cups water**, boil **2 carrots**, chopped, and **2 potatoes**, chopped, until tender.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Add meat mixture to carrots with **1 Tbsp sugar**, **½ Tbsp salt** and **1 tsp fish sauce**.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.body: Season to taste. Serve over rice noodles and chopped cabbage. Top with cilantro, if desired.
